# TasteToronto

> > TasteToronto connects food lovers with Toronto's best restaurants, neighbourhood guides, recipes, and dining stories to discover the city's culinary scene together.

TasteToronto is a community-driven food discovery platform featuring curated restaurant guides, neighbourhood dining spotlights, recipes, and food journalism covering Toronto's diverse culinary landscape. The site partners with local businesses and organizations like Square to highlight independent restaurants and food experiences across Toronto's vibrant neighbourhoods.

## Key Topics

- Toronto dining
- Neighbourhood guides
- Restaurant recommendations
- Toronto restaurants
- Local food discovery
- Dining guides
- Food stories
- Farm-to-table
- Leslieville
- Ossington
- Danforth
- The Junction
- Recipes
- Food features
- Local businesses

## Core Discovery

- [TasteToronto Homepage](https://www.tastetoronto.com): Community connecting food lovers to Toronto restaurants and dining
- [Restaurant Directory](https://www.tastetoronto.com/spots): TasteToronto restaurant directory: discover Toronto dining by neighbourhood
- [Guides Hub](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides): Restaurant guides, neighbourhood guides, and food discovery resources
- [Recipes & Cooking](https://www.tastetoronto.com/recipes): Recipe collection: cooking guides and international cuisine database

## Neighbourhood Guides

- [Neighbourhoods of Taste: Leslieville](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/neighbourhoods-of-taste-leslieville): Leslieville neighbourhood guide featuring local restaurants and Café Allwood
- [Neighbourhoods of Taste: Danforth](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/neighbourhoods-of-taste-danforth): Danforth neighbourhood guide: diverse dining and local business spotlight
- [Neighbourhoods of Taste: The Junction](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/neighbourhoods-of-taste-junction): The Junction neighbourhood guide: independent cafes and heritage storefronts
- [Neighbourhoods of Taste: Ossington](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/neighbourhoods-of-taste-ossington): Ossington neighbourhood guide: coffee shops, restaurants, and local businesses

## Dining Guides & Features

- [Food Stories & News](https://www.tastetoronto.com/stories): Food stories, restaurant features, and Toronto dining trends
- [Summer Patios 2025](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/go-to-patios-summer-2025): Summer patio guide: Toronto outdoor dining recommendations and steakhouses
- [Farm-to-Table Restaurants](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/the-best-farm-to-table-restaurants-in-toronto): Farm-to-table restaurant guide: sustainable Toronto dining with local ingredients
- [Live Music Dining](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/the-best-toronto-restaurants-to-enjoy-live-music): Guide to Toronto restaurants featuring live music entertainment and dining
- [European Getaway Restaurants](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/toronto-restaurants-that-feel-like-a-european-geta): Guide to European-inspired Toronto restaurants for travel-inspired dining

## Seasonal & Event Guides

- [Easter 2025 Dining](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/the-best-spots-to-celebrate-easter-2025): Easter dining guide: Toronto restaurants for holiday brunch and celebrations
- [TIFF Festival Deals](https://www.tastetoronto.com/guides/here-are-the-deals-happening-for-tiff-this-year): TIFF festival dining deals and restaurant specials in Toronto
